summary: Substrate for weighted associative memory: CONTEXT edges now carry an optional scalar relevance `weight` (0..1), default 0.5. overlay.js addEdge accepts+persists weight (context-only, clamped, omitted when unspecified for back-compat) and exports edgeWeight()/DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WEIGHT; daemon.js /overlay/edge forwards b.weight, depRefs/buildGraph surface it via new additive task.context_weights map, and /state (get_full_graph) returns raw edges incl. weight; mcp-core add_dependency gains optional weight:number passed through. Blocking/supersede edges unaffected (no weight). NO consumer/traversal/reinforcement logic added. New test/weighted-edges.test.js: 16/16 pass; full unit suite green (11 files, 0 fail). Daemon NOT restarted — change needs a restart to activate. Not committed.
